call_purpose: Your custom domain had been showing "site can't be reached" for three days, while your funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link but not on your own domain.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you deleted the old A record and added the CNAME record at your domain registrar and saved it, and you confirmed your domain now loads.
Following our guidance, you deleted the second www record and added a CNAME for www with the same target value, and you confirmed both your domain and its www version now load your funnel.

covered.text: We explained that an old A record pointing to an old server address was blocking the connection and needed to be replaced with a CNAME record using the target value shown in your FlexiFunnels domain settings.
We explained that the www version still showed an error because a second record for www pointed somewhere else, and needed a CNAME for www with the same target value.
We explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.

support_next_steps.text: We will check that the secure certificate has been issued and will message you if it has not.

omitted_item_ids.reason: first diagnostic check with no outcome useful to the customer
